CustomField.description: updates product type according to product ID
CustomField.formula: If (Product_ID__c = "5265" , "Personal Membership" , If (Product_ID__c = "5312" , "Family Membership" , If (Product_ID__c = "5693" , "Extend Personal Membership" , If (Product_ID__c = "5720" , "Extend Family Membership" , "False Product ID"))))
CustomField.label: Product Type
